description.value: Marilena Cafe & Raw Bar is Toptable Group's first Victoria location, bringing the same team behind Blue Water Cafe, CinCin, and Araxi to the heart of BC's capital. Executive Chef Kristian Eligh, trained at Jean-Georges and The French Laundry, leads a menu centred on local and globally sourced seafood alongside a Japanese raw bar offering nigiri, sashimi, and sushi rolls. The restaurant has earned national acclaim including No. 1 Fine Dining in Canada on Tripadvisor's Best of the Best 2025 and Best Restaurant in Victoria from Vancouver Magazine 2025–2026.
